reason: Rhombic means rhomboid. The word 'broadly' is dropped, as in the other broad-X rules.
A pseudumbel is a false umbel, so umbel-shaped is acceptable. The word is a noun, so it is mostly a bearer shape.
'Mediocre' (French médiocre) means of middle size. The part constraint already limits it.
Pseudumbellate means umbel-like.
Etched veins are impressed or sunken lines, and the constraint limits the rule to veins.
Epappose means without a pappus, so absence of pappus is right.
Vernicose means varnished and shiny, which matches glistening (synonym glossy/shiny).
Gummy means exuding or covered with gum or resin. Viscid only means sticky and loses the gum.
'Sharply defined' describes a distinct margin or limit, not conspicuousness. It has no good existing target.
Bractiform means bract-shaped.
Dusky means dark and dull. PATO low brightness has the synonym dark.
Bilaterally compressed is the same as laterally compressed.
Sac-like means saccate.
The rule loses the round shape. Round-raised is a raised, rounded structure, and prominent says nothing about shape.
Not split means undivided.
Complicate means folded upon itself, as in leaves folded lengthwise.
Non-foliaceous means not leaf-like.
The negation of glandular is kept.
Striate means striated, and the negation is kept.
The FLOPO term lists 'spicy' as a synonym. Spicy can also mean a taste, but scent is the usual use in floras.
Antheriferous means bearing anthers.
Without tubercles means not tuberculate.
Aqueous means watery, for example sap or latex.
A frilled margin is ruffled or wavy, which is close to crisped. It is not the same as fringed.
Stomatose means bearing stomata.
Without auricles means not auriculate.
Suberous is the same as suberose, which is corky.
Nervous means with visible veins (nerves). This holds for flat parts, and PO lists vein as a synonym of vascular bundle. It is doubtful for other parts.
Semi-transparent means translucent.
Bean-like means kidney-shaped, which is reniform.
As a quality, thyrsus means a thyrse-like inflorescence.
The negation of auriculate is kept.
The negation of elongated is kept.
Pseudo-umbellate is the same as pseudumbellate.
Vestigial means a rudimentary remnant. Scarcely developed only means barely developed, which is weaker.
Parallel veined means parallelodromous venation.
Biparous (a biparous cyme) means two lateral branches under the terminal flower, a dichasium. It is not bifurcated.
Ruminated, as in ruminate endosperm, means ruminate.
Imperceptible means not noticeable, so inconspicuous.
Canaliculate means channelled or grooved.
Acutely angled means angular. The word 'acutely' is dropped.
The negation of connivent is kept.
Torulose is a mild moniliform. The negation is kept.
Sandpapery means rough, which is scabrous.
Broad-elliptic is elliptic. The word 'broad' is dropped.
Contorted means twisted, and torsioned has the synonym twisted.
Ovoid is a synonym of ovate in PATO. The word 'short' is dropped.
Tardily dehiscent still means dehiscent. Only the timing is lost.
Hamate means hooked, which is a synonym of falciform in PATO.
The negation of tuberous is kept.
